item.title: Police called to a hostage situation at a bank in western Germany
item.description: Authorities say police have been called to a bank in a small town in western Germany on Friday to deal with a hostage situation in which the driver of an armored van carrying cash is being held

item.title: Pope celebrates first anniversary of election with visit to Pompeii to pray at shrine
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has marked the first anniversary of his election by praying in Pompeii
